description: This Java source file configures OAuth2 resource server security with multi-tenancy support in a Spring Boot application. It defines security filter chains, tenant-specific authentication managers, and integrates JWT and opaque token authentication providers.

classes.name: OAuth2ResourceServerSecurityConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up OAuth2 resource server security with multi-tenancy in Spring Security.

methods.name: apiSecurity
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain, setting authorization rules and OAuth2 resource server configuration.

methods.name: multitenantAuthenticationManager
methods.description: Creates a tenant-aware AuthenticationManagerResolver that selects the appropriate AuthenticationManager based on the request URI.

methods.name: jwt
methods.description: Creates a JwtAuthenticationProvider with a JwtDecoder.

methods.name: opaque
methods.description: Creates an OpaqueTokenAuthenticationProvider with an OpaqueTokenIntrospector.
